logodev_guide_title: How to get a free Logo.dev key
logodev_guide_intro: Logo.dev gives the best shop logos. One key is enough for the whole home and the free plan is plenty for family use. It takes about two minutes:
logodev_guide_step1: Open logo.dev in your browser and create a free account (email or Google/GitHub sign-in).
logodev_guide_step2: After signing in you are in the Logo.dev dashboard: open the section with the API keys.
logodev_guide_step3: Copy the “Publishable key”: it starts with pk_ (for example pk_AbC123…).
logodev_guide_step4: Never use the “Secret key”, which starts with sk_: it must stay private and Loyalty Hub refuses it.
logodev_guide_step5: In Home Assistant open Settings → Devices & services → Loyalty Hub → Configure and paste the key in the “Logo.dev key” field.
logodev_guide_step6: Leave “Test the key before saving” ticked and press Submit: if the key does not work you will see the reason right away.
logodev_guide_privacy: Only the Home Assistant server talks to Logo.dev, and it sends only the shop domain (for example coop.it): never your codes, your name or your phone's address.
logodev_test_rejected: Logo.dev refused the key: check that you copied the whole publishable key (pk_…).
logodev_test_rate_limited: Logo.dev says the monthly limit of this key has been reached. Try again later.
logodev_test_unreachable: Logo.dev could not be reached from Home Assistant. Check the internet connection and try again.
